- The modification changes the formatting from a floating-point representation (with two decimal places) to a decimal integer representation (without decimal places).

### Relationships Between Modifications
The change made in the `Shell.java` file directly addresses the bug identified in ACCUMULO-3229 by altering how the authorization timeout is displayed in the shell. Instead of showing the timeout as a floating-point number, which may imply a level of precision that is not appropriate for representing whole seconds, the modification ensures that the timeout is presented as a whole number (integer). This improves the clarity and accuracy of the information presented to the user regarding the authorization timeout setting.
